description: A photograph depicting a rural landscape under a clear blue sky, featuring a field of uniformly planted deciduous trees, characteristic of an orchard or permanent crop plantation. A wire mesh fence runs across the foreground, separating the viewer from the trees. Beyond the orchard, a grassy hill covered with additional trees and some bare patches rises in the background, topped by a denser forest. The foliage on the trees is bright green, indicating spring or summer. Faint, partially obscured text "2013 COPERNICUS LAND" is visible in the bottom left corner.
